name: Yatra 2.0 — local
description:
Local environment for the Yatra 2.0 collection. Select it in the top-right picker; with it selected, `baseUrl` points at a locally running app and the two demo credentials are filled in.

**Only values a human configures live here.** The transient ones — `adminToken`, `userToken`, `bookingId`, `pendingBookingId`, `today` — deliberately do **not**: Postman resolves an environment variable *before* a collection variable, so an `adminToken` defined here would shadow the one the sign-in request captures and every admin call would go out with an empty Bearer token. The collection defines them (and their defaults) instead.

The credentials are the seeder's documented demo account (`SeedService.DEMO_PASSWORD`), not a secret — demo data nobody can sign into is not demo data. See the standards doc, open question 8.
